caption: The drawing displays a decorative ornamental object in the center of the page, rendered in shades of gold and brown with fine detailing. The design features vertical symmetry, with the main body forming an elongated, upright shape adorned with intricate patterns, including swirling and feather-like motifs. At the top, there are two prominent upward and outward curving scrolls, intersected by a central spiraled form. Flanking the main body, there are matching feathered or leaf-like decorations on each side. The central panel contains ornate, swirling designs, complemented by fine, crosshatched sections near the lower part. The bottom edge of the object is curved and partly cropped by the edge of the image. The object is placed against a plain, off-white background, and near the lower left, the name "Albert Levere" is written in small, cursive script.
title: Rifle Patchbox
